다음.없음: Next: nothing. Start with “value <company> for me”.

안내.1: Install Python 3.11 or later (python.org). You have to install it yourself.
안내.3: With Excel: pip install pywin32. Without Excel: pip install formulas — used to recalculate workbook formulas.
안내.5: Letter PDF and video need Edge or Chrome and ffmpeg (the letter text and HTML work without them).
안내.6:
Only needed for Korean companies: a free OpenDART API key. Individuals get it right away.
  1) opendart.fss.or.kr 2) top menu 「인증키 신청/관리」 → 「인증키 신청」 3) choose individual, enter e-mail, password, environment and purpose 4) the 40-character key arrives by e-mail.
  Store it from a terminal with `python -X utf8 스크립트/준비점검.py --저장 OPENDART_API_KEY`. It is not shown on screen and is kept only in this computer's environment variables. Details: 시작하기_인증키.md
안내.7:
For US companies the SEC asks for a contact: nothing to issue, no sign-up; your own e-mail address.
  Store it with `python -X utf8 스크립트/준비점검.py --저장 SEC_CONTACT_EMAIL`. Details: 시작하기_인증키.md
안내.8: Cannot reach DART — see the cause below.
안내.9: Cannot reach SEC — see the cause below.
안내.10: Korean companies need the DART MCP connection. ADDER uses it to look up filings — add a DART MCP server (`dart`) to `.mcp.json` and restart Claude (see `.mcp.예시.json`).
안내.11: The base-rate panel is optional. With it, letters get “how did similar companies actually do” signals — `python 스크립트/기저율.py --받기`.
안내.12: A newer version exists — run `/plugin marketplace update adder`, then `/adder:키트갱신` in this folder.
안내.13: Cannot write to this folder or the shared cache — reopen in a folder you can write to.
안내.14:
To fetch tax tables and statute text from the Ministry of Government Legislation you need an OC value from open.law.go.kr: sign up → 「OPEN API 신청」 → approval by staff (1–2 days) → check it under 「API인증키관리」.
  Store it with `python -X utf8 스크립트/준비점검.py --저장 LAW_OC`. Without it the kit uses the bundled tax tables and statute cache. Details: 시작하기_인증키.md
안내.15: Allow python execution, WebSearch and WebFetch in Claude settings (or permissions.allow in ~/.claude/settings.json). Branch subagents cannot show approval prompts and stop without these rules. You must change permission settings yourself.
안내.16: Bank of Korea ECOS key (optional) — ecos.bok.or.kr/api 「인증키 신청」. This version of the kit runs without it. `--저장 ECOS_API_KEY` · Details: 시작하기_인증키.md
안내.17: KOSIS key (optional) — kosis.kr/openapi 「활용신청」 (approved automatically). This version of the kit runs without it. `--저장 KOSIS_API_KEY` · Details: 시작하기_인증키.md

저장.물음: Paste the value and press Enter (empty = later):
저장.됨: Saved ({곳}). Open a new terminal and restart Claude so the MCP picks it up.
저장.보류: Noted as “later” (deferred). You will be asked again the first time you value a company from that market.

첫시작: First time? Add your keys first. This computer has neither a DART API key nor an SEC contact.
· Korean companies: OpenDART API key (free · individuals get it right away) → `python -X utf8 스크립트/준비점검.py --저장 OPENDART_API_KEY`
· US companies: your own e-mail (nothing to issue) → `python -X utf8 스크립트/준비점검.py --저장 SEC_CONTACT_EMAIL`
· Where to apply, which menus, what to keep private: 시작하기_인증키.md in the kit folder
· To do both later, run `python -X utf8 스크립트/준비점검.py --설치` and leave the values empty (recorded as “later”).
